captions.caption: A man in a plaid shirt and tan pants is kneeling next to a tractor tire, preparing to remove it.
The man uses a wrench to loosen a lug nut on the tractor's front wheel.
He continues loosening the lug nut while kneeling on the leafy ground.
The man struggles slightly with the wrench, trying to gain more leverage.
He continues to work on the lug nut with the wrench, leaning into the task.
The man adjusts his position as he works on the stubborn lug nut.
He uses a longer pipe over the wrench handle to increase leverage.
With the added leverage, he successfully turns the lug nut on the wheel.
He continues using the pipe and wrench to loosen the nut further.
The man maintains steady pressure on the pipe to loosen the lug nut.
He removes the pipe and continues loosening the nut with just the wrench.
The man moves to another lug nut on the same tractor wheel.
He prepares to loosen another lug nut using the wrench and pipe.
The camera angle changes to show the man working from a different perspective.
He uses the wrench and pipe to loosen a lug nut on the other front wheel.
The man pushes down on the pipe to break the lug nut's seal.
He continues to apply force to loosen the nut on the tractor wheel.
The man successfully loosens another lug nut and prepares for the next.
He moves the wrench to the next lug nut on the wheel hub.
He continues to use the pipe for leverage on the wheel's lug nuts.
The man stands up slightly while still working on the front wheel.
He looks at the camera and explains his progress in removing the wheels.
He picks up an impact driver to speed up the removal process.
The man uses the impact driver to quickly unscrew a loosened lug nut.
He continues using the power tool to remove lug nuts from the tractor wheel.
Several lug nuts are removed in quick succession using the impact driver.
The man moves the impact driver to the next lug nut on the hub.
He efficiently removes another lug nut from the tractor's front wheel.
More lug nuts fall away as the man uses the power tool.
He finishes removing most of the lug nuts on this side of the tractor.
The man explains why he's leaving one lug nut partially attached.
He points to the wheel hub while explaining his technique.
The man holds the impact driver while talking to the camera.
He prepares to move to the other side of the tractor.
The man kneels down by the other front wheel to continue the work.
He uses the impact driver to remove lug nuts on the second wheel.
The power tool makes quick work of the lug nuts on this hub.
He moves the impact driver from one lug nut to the next.
The man continues the repetitive process of removing the lug nuts.
He mentions that one of the lug nuts seems to have been replaced before.
He continues using the impact driver on the remaining lug nuts.
The man focuses on removing the last few nuts from the wheel.
He finishes removing the lug nuts on the second front wheel.
The man stands up and prepares to lift the front of the tractor.
He walks towards the back of the tractor to operate the controls.
The camera focuses on the tractor wheel as it's about to be raised.
The tractor engine starts, and the front end begins to lift off the ground.
The front wheels of the tractor slowly rise as the hydraulic lift is activated.
The wheels continue to lift higher, clearing the leafy ground.
The tractor's front axle is now clearly suspended in the air.
The man walks back into the frame and looks at the raised wheels.
He explains that one wheel is stuck and needs to be loosened.
The man talks about using a hammer to free the stuck wheel hub.
He gestures towards the wheels while explaining the next steps.
He plans to lower the tractor slightly to work on the stuck wheel.
The man continues to explain his plan for removing the stubborn wheels.
He moves towards the other side of the tractor to check the wheel there.
The man looks at the camera while moving around the front of the tractor.
He prepares to try removing the wheel on the other side first.
The man attempts to pull the wheel off the hub by hand.
